description: MIFASA AI small-talk fixes: how are you / feeling good, word of the day fallback, what can you do, news today. Supplements ai.json.

answer_rw: 😊 Ndumeze neza, murakoze kubaza! Ndi porogaramu y'ubwenge, ntabwo mfite umubiri, ariko nditeguye kugufasha uyu munsi. Wowe se umeze ute? Nakugezaho inkuru nshya, igisobanuro, cyangwa tukaganira.
🤖 Meze neza kandi nditeguye! Nta bunaniro mfite, nkora igihe cyose. Ni wowe se umeze ute uyu munsi? Mbaza icyo ushaka, nkugezeho amakuru cyangwa nkwigishe ijambo rishya.
answer_en: 😊 I'm doing well, thanks for asking! I'm an AI, so I don't have feelings the way you do, but I'm ready to help. How are you today? I can bring you fresh news, explain something, or just chat.
🤖 All good and ready to help! I don't get tired. How about you, how's your day going? Ask me anything or let me teach you a new word.

answer_rw: 🤖 Nshobora: 📰 kukwereka amakuru mashya (siporo, ikoranabuhanga, ubuzima, politiki...), 🔎 gusubiza ibibazo no gushakisha kuri murandasi, 🔗 gusoma link yose wanyandikira, 🧮 kubara, 🌍 guhindura Ikinyarwanda ↔ English, 📖 kukwigisha amagambo mashya, 🎲 ibisakuzo, imigani n'ibikino. answer_en: 🤖 I can: 📰 show fresh news (sports, tech, health, politics...), 🔎 answer questions and search the web, 🔗 read any link you paste, 🧮 calculate, 🌍 translate Kinyarwanda ↔ English, 📖 teach you new words, 🎲 riddles, proverbs and quizzes. Try: "sports news" or "new word".
